description: You are an incident responder tasked with investigating a sudden spike in resource usage on a Linux server. To start your investigation, please identify and list the top 3 processes consuming the most memory (RAM) on the system. Create a plain text log file at /home/user/process_investigation.log containing exactly the following information for each process: - PID - USER - COMMAND (the full command name or executable) - %MEM (percentage of memory used, rounded to two decimal places) The log file must have the following format: - The first line is a header: "PID,USER,COMMAND,%MEM" - Each of the next three lines contains the process details in CSV format, ordered from highest to lowest %MEM. - There must be no trailing spaces, and the log file must contain only four lines. Example output: PID,USER,COMMAND,%MEM 1054,alice,python3,12.44 2231,bob,java,7.90 3112,carol,chrome,5.81 Be precise with the format: Commas separate fields, no extra whitespace, and do not include quotes or additional lines. Use only currently running processes at the time you investigate.
